gap: No result ChatGPT got states how many hours of full-rated sun a station's own solar kit needs to put back one night of furnace use (about 11 h for a 200 W panel against a 2,260 Wh PSC night), nor that at today's prices the BLUETTI Elite 200 V2 + 200 W kit ($1,199) costs exactly what the bare Elite 300 ($1,199) does while holding 45% less usable energy.
standout_why: Outage Authority (cited) has per-model furnace-only runtime at 50%/77% duty and cost per rated Wh for two models (C2000 Gen 2 $0.49, Elite 200 V2 $0.67 at its 11-03 price of $1,399); UDPOWER has Wh-per-8-hour-night tables for generic loads; Capable Home has runtime at 800/490 W for three stations; Prepared States has generic 1/2 kWh figures. None gives nights-per-charge, refill hours from the kit's own panel, Wh per lb, or cost per usable Wh; and Outage Authority's $/Wh ranking is stale: Elite 200 V2 is $899 today, $0.43 per rated Wh, undercutting its recommended C2000 Gen 2.
decides: For furnace backup buy stored capacity, not a panel: the Elite 300 at $1,199 gives about 2,562 usable Wh (1.1 mild PSC nights) for $0.47 per usable Wh, while the same $1,199 on the Elite 200 V2 + 200 W kit gives 1,763 usable Wh plus a panel that at full rating recovers only about 1/11 of a night per hour of sun. The $899 Elite 200 V2 is the value pick per usable Wh ($0.51) if 0.8 of a mild night is enough; the ALLPOWERS R4000 ($0.51 per usable Wh, 1.3 nights) is sold out today.

findings.label: Furnace running draw used for all derivations
findings.value: 565 W PSC / 359 W ECM while burner on; 50% duty mild night, 77% at design low
findings.source_title: Can a Power Station Run Your Gas Furnace in an Outage? | Outage Authority
findings.note: Outage Authority quotes LBNL model and NRC field measurements: PSC blower 490 W + inducer 75 W = 565 W; ECM 284 W + 75 W = 359 W. Per hour of furnace: 565 × 0.5 = 282.5 Wh (PSC mild), 565 × 0.77 = 435 Wh (PSC design low), 359 × 0.5 = 179.5 Wh (ECM mild). One 8-hour night (night length per UDPOWER, https://udpwr.com/blogs/portable-power-station-knowledge/backup-generator-for-gas-furnace, read 2026-11-08): PSC mild 2,260 Wh, PSC design low 3,480 Wh, ECM mild 1,436 Wh. 85% usable assumed throughout.
